subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：cis-Dichlorobis(ethylenediamine)cobalt(III)（cis-[CoCl₂(en)₂]⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Trigonal bipyramidal
D. Square pyramidal
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Co (group 9) 9 e; 2 × Cl (X) 2 e; 2 × en (L₂) 8 e; the 1+ charge removes 1 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex has a 1+ charge, so the metal is Co(III), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e.
